text.tspan: The Living Planet Index (LPI) measures the average decline in monitored wildlife populations. The index value
measures the change in abundance in 35,803 populations across 5,790 native species relative to the year 1970

tspan.tspan: World Wildlife Fund and Zoological Society of London (2026)
